product.ta-bss-200.summary: The BSS 200 was a writing system with its own service documentation in the BSS range.
product.ta-bss-200.history: Triumph-Adler lists it separately in its 1993 technical catalogue.
product.ta-bss-200.technical.configurati: The references identify its service documentation. The catalogue lists BS102 in German and BS103 in English.
product.ta-bss-200.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-bss-200.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
